observations.note: About 248k tokens were read before the first edit and context peaked near 353k, so the retry should be handed a narrower reading list instead of re-reading all rule files, specs and engine code.
Six consecutive greps of the same pattern at different line-length thresholds were probing that one check could have settled.
The 500-character line check was repeated across files and edit passes, where one scoped search at the end would do.
With no git or shell the retry had to hunt for other copies of the original sentences to undo a prior attempt's edits to existing specs, and it could not run the structure check itself.
